text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text: Oh my, is something wrong? Did something from the last lesson confuse you?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あら、
どうかしたの？
さっきの授業で分からないところでもあった？

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text: Umm... it's true that today is my birthday... Is this perhaps a birthday present for me?
text_block_list.orig_text:
えっと……
確かに
今日は私の誕生日だけど……
もしかしてこれ、
私への誕生日プレゼント？

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text: ...Hehe. Thank you for remembering. However, don't bring anything to school that isn't related to studying, okay?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……ふふっ。
覚えててくれてありがとう。
でも、
お勉強と関係ないものを持ってきちゃダメよ？

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text: Sensei will take care of this for you. After school, come see me to get it back.
text_block_list.orig_text:
これは先生が預かっておくわね。
放課後、
先生のところに来るように。

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry you know? For being so roundabout. But... there were too many eyes on us in the hallway... you understand, don't you?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ごめんなさいね。
なんだか回りくどいことしちゃって。
でも、
廊下は他の生徒の目があったから……
ね？

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text: Here. As promised, I'll return this present to you. So...
text_block_list.orig_text:
はい。
約束通り、
このプレゼントは返すわ。
それで……

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text: It's already after school. Could you... do it again?
text_block_list.orig_text:
もう放課後だから。
改めて……
いいかしら。

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text: Hehe, doing something like this on the school rooftop... My heart is beating so fast♪ You don't believe me? Want to listen... to its sound...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふふっ、
学校の屋上でこんなことするなんて。
とっても胸がドキドキするわね♪
本当よ？　
音……
聞いてみる……？
